scope: Native in-memory pcbnew checks, text/netlist contract faults, synthetic reference/region fixtures and isolated fab-manifest copies. No CLI DRC/ERC, check.sh or build executed by this lens. No full-gate seed survival claim.

findings.title: Individual textbox legends and plus/minus polarity evade terminal conflict checks
Required-population set omits the functional core
findings.other_coverage: r10_sch_check.contract rejects each mirrored schematic DNP fault; manifest catches an unrebound PCB change. Full build preflight dispatches the schematic contract.

findings.title: Nonfinite or degenerate model transforms can pass fit and wire-room checks

excluded_exploration: Unscored fixtures were discarded when a mask collision, unrouted-board guard, unchanged model copy, or a gate-bias branch confounded the intended fault. Corrected native faults and paired controls are recorded here.
